title: San Francisco Crime Data Story
text:
Crime in San Francisco
This is a data-driven look at crime in San Francisco using police department reports from 2003 to the present.



Crime Trends Over Time
import pandas as pd import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
file1 = r”C:_Department_Incident_Reports__Historical_2003_to_May_2018.csv” file2 = r”C:_Department_Incident_Reports__2018_to_Present_20250204.csv”
df1 = pd.read_csv(file1) df2 = pd.read_csv(file2) df = pd.concat([df1, df2], ignore_index=True)
if ‘Incident Category’ in df.columns: df = df[df[‘Incident Category’] != ‘Prostitution’]
df[‘Date’] = pd.to_datetime(df[‘Incident Date’], errors=‘coerce’) df = df.dropna(subset=[‘Date’]) df[‘Year’] = df[‘Date’].dt.year
yearly = df.groupby(‘Year’).size()
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 4)) yearly.plot(kind=‘bar’, color=‘royalblue’) plt.title(“San Francisco Police Reports per Year”) plt.ylabel(“Number of Incidents”) plt.xlabel(“Year”) plt.tight_layout() plt.show()
